attributes.name: _currentBehaviorState
attributes.description: Internal state tracking the current behavior implementation

attributes.name: _hasTriggerContent
attributes.description: Whether the trigger slot contains any elements

attributes.name: _open
attributes.description: Whether the layover is open or not

attributes.name: allowBodyScroll
attributes.description: Allow scrolling of the body when the dialog is open

attributes.name: behavior
attributes.description: The behavior of the popover, "dialog", "dialog-fullscreen", "dropdown", "tooltip", or "input", "input-fullscreen", "input-dropdown"

attributes.name: disabled
attributes.description: Whether or not the layover is disabled (show/hide should be fully disabled)

attributes.name: hideOnNoValue
attributes.description: Whether or not the layover should close when there is no value (input behavior only)

attributes.name: inline
attributes.description: Whether or not the layover should try to align to an inline element like a hyperlink

attributes.name: input
attributes.description: A reference to the input to attach to for input behavior

attributes.name: matchWidth
attributes.description: Whether or not the popover should match the width of the trigger

attributes.name: minInputLength
attributes.description: The minimum number of characters the user must type before the popover is shown

attributes.name: offset
attributes.description: The offset distance of the layover

attributes.name: placement
attributes.description: The position of the layover, e.g., "bottom-start", "top-end" etc. (do not use with useAutoPlacement)

attributes.name: shown
attributes.description: Whether the layover is shown or not

attributes.name: showOnChange
attributes.description: Whether the layover should show on change (input behavior only)

attributes.name: showOnFocus
attributes.description: Whether the layover should open on focus (input behavior only)

attributes.name: showOnHover
attributes.description: Whether the layover should show on hover

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: The title of the layover - REQUIRED FOR A11Y

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: The type of layover, e.g., "manual", "auto", or "hint"

attributes.name: useAutoPlacement
attributes.description: Whether or not to use automatic placement for the layover (do not use with placement)

attributes.name: useFlip
attributes.description: Whether or not to use the flip behavior (flips the element when it goes off-screen)

attributes.name: useHide
attributes.description: Whether or not to use the hide behavior (hides element when trigger is not visible)

Checks for an input element in the trigger slot

If it finds a valid input element, it sets it as the input element.

declarations.description:
AuroLayover is a web component that provides a customizable popover element.
It supports various behaviors such as dialog, dropdown, tooltip, and input.

declarations.description:
LayerManager
Manages a global stack of layover layers to ensure proper layering and closing behavior.
declarations.name: LayerManager

members.name: #initializeStack
members.description:
Ensures the global layover stack is available for managing active layover layers. 
This method prepares the shared window state so other methods can reliably track layers.

members.name: addLayer
members.description:
Adds a layer to the global layover stack and ensures it is treated as the topmost layer.
This method maintains layer ordering so the most recently added layover is tracked last.

members.name: hideLayer

parameters.name: layer
parameters.description: The layer to attempt to hide while constraining to the top layer

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: The callback to call if the layer should be hidden

members.description:
Attempts to hide a layover layer while enforcing that only the active top layer is allowed to close.
This method coordinates layer closing behavior, invoking an optional callback when the hide is permitted.

members.name: removeLayer
members.description:
Removes a layer from the global layover stack if it is currently tracked.
This method updates the shared stack so that closed or inactive layovers are no longer considered.
